title: aes-192, 12 rounds: Related-key rectangle / table extraction [LCS+23]

target.description: The source-defined 12-round AES construction, with standard key schedule and the source output-linear-layer convention.

setting.key_relation: Four unknown keys defined through standard AES-192 schedule-state maps H_i: KB=H_1^-1(H_1(KA) XOR DeltaK1), KC=H_4^-1(H_4(KA) XOR NablaK4), KD=H_4^-1(H_4(KB) XOR NablaK4). H_i maps the master key to the192-bit state starting at round i. The specified differences and their schedule switch are from BK09; these are not generally fixed master-key XOR offsets.
setting.key_population: General unknown AES-192 key with the source-prescribed schedule-state related-key oracles; propagated unknown Table2 cells are not a reported weak-key fraction.
setting.plaintext_model: Four chosen-plaintext lists of 2^121 records each; 2^123 encryption queries in total.
assumptions: The generic fixed-XOR rectangle illustration does not define the actual BK09/LCS23 schedule-derived key functions. Standard key-schedule propagation and the stated oracle functions are required.

data.note: Aggregate across all four keys, not per-key.

memory.note: Source-native pair storage; record width is not specified in bytes or AES blocks.
